title: AI-Based Real-Time Elephant Monitoring and Human Elephant Conflict Mitigation System
summary: MUST proposes learning from elephant movement logs to predict conflicts; its existing GPS and fixed-geofence prototype is not counted as an AI benefit.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The existing prototype tracks GPS positions, applies fixed geofences, and sends alerts through conventional electronics. A future machine-learning module would use movement logs and contextual data to predict elephant behavior and conflicts. This record concerns that proposed prediction function and its intended protection of people, crops, and wildlife. It does not attribute the current geofence alerts to AI.
purpose: Predict elephant conflicts to support earlier protective action.
system: AI-Based Real-Time Elephant Monitoring and Human Elephant Conflict Mitigation System
location: Tanzanian elephant corridors near farms and villages (planned)

ratings.reason: Earlier warnings from the proposed ML predictor could protect people and crops, but no AI-produced safety or livelihood outcome is reported.
Reduced conflict and retaliatory harm through learned prediction remain intended outcomes.

ai_role.statement: Future ML would infer behavior and conflict risk from logged movements and contextual data, beyond fixed proximity thresholds.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 20: AI-Based Real-Time Elephant Monitoring and Human Elephant Conflict Mitigation System

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Proposed ML predicts elephant conflicts from movement logs

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
